auth.description: Enter your Billplz API Secret Key. You can find this in your Billplz account settings.

create_bill.name: create_bill
create_bill.description: Create a new bill within a collection

collection_id.description: Select the collection to create the bill in

auth.description: Enter your Billplz API Secret Key. You can find this in your Billplz account settings.

email.description: Recipient email address (required if mobile not provided)

mobile.description: Recipient mobile number with country code (required if email not provided)

amount.description: Amount in Malaysian Ringgit (e.g., 2.00 for RM 2.00)

description.description: Bill description that will be displayed on the bill

callback_url.description: Webhook URL to receive payment completion notifications

due_at.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, defaults to today)

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect customer after payment completion

deliver.description: Automatically send email and SMS notification to recipient

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Billplz bill (payment request) inside a given collection, charging a recipient identified by email and/or mobile for an amount in Malaysian Ringgit. Either email or mobile is required, along with a recipient name, description, and callback URL; optionally set a due date, redirect URL, and reference fields. Enabling the deliver option sends the recipient an email/SMS notification. Not idempotent: each call creates a distinct bill and may dispatch a notification.

get_bill.name: get_bill
get_bill.description: Retrieve information about a specific bill

bill_id.description: The ID of the bill to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Billplz bill by its bill ID, returning its details and payment status. Use to check whether a bill has been paid or to fetch its current state. Requires a known bill ID. Idempotent: a read-only lookup with no side effects.

get_collections.name: get_collections
get_collections.description: Triggers when there are new collections

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new Billplz collection appears on the authenticated account. Polls the collections list and emits one event per newly detected collection, representing a container into which bills can be created.
